missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Больница' is feminine and stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Новая' and 'большая' are the agreeing feminine adjectives, and 'очень' intensifies the description.
Strategic focus: Accusative of destination. 'Больницу' takes the accusative after 'в' to express motion toward a place. 'Еду' shows directed movement, and 'завтра' sets the time.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Больницы' is the genitive form after 'нет', stating that no hospital exists nearby. 'Рядом с домом' gives the location frame.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Больнице' takes the dative after 'к', expressing motion toward the building. 'Идёт' shows the doctor approaching on foot.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'В больнице' uses the prepositional form 'больнице' after 'в' to mean working inside the hospital. 'Медсестрой' is the instrumental of role.
Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 'Больницу' is the accusative object of 'видим'. 'Большую' agrees in the feminine accusative, and 'впереди' marks where it stands.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Больницей' takes the instrumental after 'перед', meaning in front of the hospital. 'Стоит' fixes the ambulance in place.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Больниц' is the genitive plural required by 'несколько'. 'Новых' agrees in the genitive plural, and 'в городе' sets the place.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Больницы' is the nominative plural subject. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and the predicate 'оборудованы' describes their condition.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Больнице' takes the dative after 'к' to show where the road leads. 'Прямо' emphasizes the straight route toward the building.
